project_type: React 18 SPA with Vite bundler, Zustand state management, react-router-dom routing
build_system: Vite via npm scripts, top-level Makefile wraps npm commands
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom environment, @testing-library/react, setup file at src/test-setup.ts
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run build' in frontend/ to verify TypeScript compiles and bundle builds. 2. Run 'npm run typecheck' to confirm no type errors. 3. Run 'npm run test -- --run' to confirm existing tests still pass.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network - can install npm packages from public registry. No Docker daemon needed for verification (use build + typecheck).
contribution_requirements: Visual layer only - do NOT change business logic, stores, or engines. All existing functionality must continue working.
key_patterns: Path alias '@/' maps to 'src/'. Components use inline styles exclusively. Stores use Zustand 5. All components are functional with hooks. tsconfig targets ES2022 with strict mode and noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters.
directory_structure: frontend/src/: App.tsx (main canvas page), main.tsx (router + entry), canvas/ (Konva canvas), components/ (UI components with inline styles), engines/ (business logic), hooks/, lib/, pages/ (DashboardPage, auth pages, admin/), stores/ (Zustand stores), types/
